title: Day 1 of using this App
body:
I will try to keep adding review for this app for next few days. 

First day Rating 3

I like the UI and the design. Mainly the idea of this app. I tend to forget and focus on things to do. I think this app will definitely help me in staying focus and meeting my day to day goals.

I wonder if you could have an API sending and receiving data to Apple Watch/ or health app, where it can track steps / running/ workout activity and complete itself ?
This would really up the game of this app. 

I already like the idea of having a widget for this app on my home screen.

And I do agree with few viewers that the initial package that you offer is a little expensive and when I clicked on offer for me only, I was surprised to see a discount. 

I am trying it out to work on myself. Also I am not worried about the subscription that I paid to, as if I don’t like it or it’s not working you have Money Back Guarantee. 

Overall, good app and design, few more improvements and capabilities or features would up the game.

Thank you for your efforts in making this app. 

Look forward from hearing from you about this review.
